title: Sunflower Keys — Let two colors answer in a block a braid and a return
help: These six seeds share only the lowest and highest note colors. A block waits before answering, a braid alternates, and a return comes home to the low color. The places remain distinct. Choose Drawn to hear these orders; planting is silent.
message: phrases experiments keep the supplied choices silent and reversible
facts: Every row uses exactly0/4/5/9/10/14 once; modulo5 means colors0 and4, three notes each. Drawn is the authored order; Radial sorts the same set. All unique seeds are within0..232. These are existing pentatonic palette colors, not a semitone or octave claim.
